caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a stylized horse figure oriented in profile, facing left. The horse has a textured surface with a mix of reddish-brown and gray tones, giving it a mottled, rust-like appearance. The mane and tail are jagged and spiked, with the tail extending straight and ending in pointed tips. The horse is shown in a running pose with its left front and right rear legs extended forward, and the right front and left rear legs extended backward. There is a vertical cylindrical post shown attached to or passing through the front left leg, crossing down to the ground. The background is plain and neutral, off-white in color, and the bottom right corner contains small handwriting.
title: Weather Vane - Horse
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
